integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone standard-library exact-rational checker; finite enumeration corroborates but is not the proof. Publication-priority search has residual unindexed-literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Only two agents; at least one asymmetric-cost chore; binary additive chores; strong WEFX includes zero-cost-item removals; fractional Pareto efficiency and exact (not approximate) ex-ante WEF. No generality to all-shared instances, more agents, other value domains or alternate EFX definitions. Formal peer/independent scientific validation has not occurred.
title: The collapse of lottery feasibility for heterogeneous two-agent binary chores
